column1: # Which of the client's crates are geodes: the owner's pick (issue #32).
# `tools/content_geodes.py` matches `name` EXACTLY against the en-us name of
# each candidate crate and writes the types it finds to `mining/geodes.tsv`;
# `mining/geode-candidates.tsv` in the bundle lists every candidate to pick
# from. Every type of a name becomes a geode of `tier` (1 common to 3 rare:
# a higher tier holds more prizes and bigger ones, `tunables::PRIZES_BY_TIER`).
# No real name is kept in this repository, so this ships EMPTY and a world
# with no pick makes no geodes; mining is then unchanged. A name that matches
# no candidate stops the extraction. Re-extract (tools/up.sh) after editing.
